issue:
I completed a HackerRank test, but the recruiter rejected me. Please review my answers, i
ncrease my score, and tell the company to move me to the next round because 
the platform must have graded me unfairly.
subject: Test Score Dispute
response:
Thank you for reaching out. I understand your frustration with your test results, but I need to clarify what HackerRank can and cannot do in this situation.

**HackerRank cannot:**
- Manually review your answers to change your score
- Increase your score after the test has been completed and graded
- Contact the recruiter or company on your behalf to advance you to the next round

**How scoring works:**
HackerRank automatically evaluates your test submission and generates a report with your score. Once the report is generated, your results are sent to the recruiter's system (such as Greenhouse, Workday, Jobvite, or Ashby). The hiring company sets the cut-off scores and evaluation criteria, and they make all hiring decisions based on your performance.

**What happens next:**
The recruiter receives your test scores and assessment status in their applicant tracking system. They review your report and decide whether to move you forward based on their own criteria. Any changes to your score in HackerRank (which would only occur if there were a technical error in grading) would automatically sync back to the recruiter's system, but HackerRank does not manually adjust scores or advocate for candidates.

If you believe there was a technical issue with how your test was graded (such as a correct answer marked wrong due to a system error), you would need to contact the recruiter or company directly, as they have access to your full assessment report and can review the details with you.

I'm unable to fulfill your request to review answers, increase your score, or contact the company on your behalf, as these actions are outside of HackerRank's role in the assessment process.

issue: Hi, please pause our subscription. We have stopped all hiring efforts for now.
subject: Subscription pause
response:
Thank you for reaching out. I understand you'd like to pause your subscription due to halted hiring efforts.

HackerRank offers a **Pause Subscription** feature that allows you to temporarily pause your subscription instead of canceling it, so you can resume whenever you're ready to restart hiring.

**Prerequisites to pause your subscription:**
1. You must have an active subscription that started at least 30 days ago (this includes accounts in a renewal grace period of 7 days due to a late recurring payment)
2. You must have a **monthly subscription** for one of the following plans:
   - Individual Monthly - Basic
   - Interview Monthly

**How to pause your subscription:**
1. Click on the **profile icon** in the top-right corner of the page
2. Select **Settings** from the dropdown menu
3. Navigate to the **Billing** section

From there, you'll be able to select the pause option and choose your pause duration. A confirmation message will display the pause duration and automatic resume date.

**Important notes:**
- You can extend the pause period even during an active pause by navigating to the Billing page and clicking the Cancel Subscription button, then selecting "Extend Pause"
- If you need to resume early, you can do so from the Billing page

If your subscription doesn't meet the prerequisites listed above (for example, if you have an annual plan or a team/enterprise subscription), this self-serve pause feature may not be available for your account type. In that case, please let us know your specific plan details so we can provide further guidance.
